Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

Given the following question and four candidate answers (A, B, C and D), choose the best answer.
Question: A group of friends decided to go camping for the weekend. They gathered some tree branches and built a campfire. What type of energy of the tree branches did the friends use?
A. heat energy
B. kinetic energy
C. chemical energy
D. mechanical energy
Respond with one of the four choices (A, B, C or D).
